headline: P&G Revenue Beats Estimates but Rising Commodity Costs Hit Profit Guidance
summary: Procter & Gamble reported better-than-expected first-quarter revenue and earnings. However, the consumer products giant warned that rising commodity costs will create a larger drag on full-year profits.
why: Procter & Gamble is one of the world's largest consumer staple manufacturers, serving as a key bellwether for global consumer spending and input cost inflation.

impacts.name: Procter & Gamble Co
impacts.why: Quarterly sales beat expectations, but conservative earnings guidance tied to commodity inflation capped investor enthusiasm.

why_moved: Solid quarterly revenue sent shares higher in premarket trading, but higher projected commodity costs limited gains by signaling margin pressure.
